newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen cheered by overseas, but quiet.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen cheered by overseas, but quiet.

text.p: Shares were seen opening slightly ahead, helped by positive sentiment overseas, brokers said: but the session looked set to be uneventful so Nokia may not manage another test on resistance.

Its ADR fell to around the equivalent of 337.67 markka in New York overnight: "The question today is if Nokia goes through (its life-high) 340, but I doubt it will," a broker said. "I don't believe there's enough power in the domestic market now."
"I expect total trade will be less than yesterday," another broker said. "The day will be tame, there aren't many results coming." -- Helsinki newsroom +3589 6805 0247
